prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” roofing company for every Dallas roof replacement — the right contractor depends on your neighborhood, roof type (asphalt shingle, metal, tile), budget, whether you’re filing an insurance claim, desired warranty and timeline. I can help you pick the best option for your situation. To get started, answer a couple quick questions:
- What ZIP code or neighborhood are you in?
- Roof type and approximate age/condition?
- Is this an insurance claim or a cash/homeowner-paid job?
- Any preference for manufacturer-certified installers (GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed, etc.)?

Meanwhile, here’s a practical checklist and process you can use to find the best Dallas roofing contractor:

What to require from every roofer
- Local registration/license and local Dallas contact/address.
- Proof of general liability insurance and worker’s comp (request certificates).
- Manufacturer certification (GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed) if you want extended warranties.
- Written, itemized estimate (tear-off or overlay, materials, labor, permit fees, disposal).
- Clear start and finish dates and a written payment schedule.
- Written manufacturer warranty + separate workmanship warranty (length and terms).
- Commitment to handle permits and inspections.
- Agreement to provide lien waivers at final payment.

Questions to ask each company
- How long have you been doing roof replacements in Dallas?
- Can you provide 3 local references or recent jobs I can inspect?
- Are you manufacturer-certified? Which brands?
- Who will supervise the crew on site?
- How do you handle unexpected damage or additional costs?
- What is the payment schedule and final inspection process?
- Do you provide a written cleanup and contingency plan for weather?

Red flags to avoid
- No written estimate or contract.
- Asks for full payment upfront or large cash-only deposit.
- No proof of insurance or won’t provide COI naming you as additional insured when requested.
- Pushy “storm-chaser” sales tactics after a storm (high-pressure, limited-time offers).
- Poor or inconsistent online reviews and no local references.

How to compare bids
- Compare like-for-like: same shingle brand, warranty, tear-off vs. overlay, ventilation upgrades, ice/water shield, flashings.
- Score each bid by price, warranty quality, references, responsiveness, and professionalism.
- Don’t automatically pick the cheapest — weigh workmanship warranty and local reputation.

Where to check reputation
- Google Maps/Google Reviews
- Better Business Bureau (BBB)
- Yelp and Angi/HomeAdvisor
- Nextdoor or neighborhood Facebook groups for local recommendations

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short phone/email script you can use with contractors.
- Help you compare 3 estimates if you post them (line-item comparisons).
- Suggest a short list of Dallas contractors if you give your ZIP code — I’ll explain how to verify any companies you’re considering.

Tell me your ZIP and a few details and I’ll tailor recommendations and a script to call/email roofers.
